pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes #5319

## List

- Create a DatabaseStats struct
- Compute and store the documents database stats in the IndexStats
- Force dumpless upgrade to update the index stats
- when a document addition/modification/deletion is made, we only recompute the database stats on the added/modified/deleted documents

issue_context.title: Add documents database metrics to `stats` route
issue_context.body:
related PR: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/pull/5325

Make the `/stats` route return several metrics related to the document stored in Meilisearch.

## Usage

GET: `/stats`

```json
{
  "databaseSize": 438272,
  "usedDatabaseSize": 196608,
  "lastUpdate": "2025-01-23T11:36:22.634859166Z",
  "indexes": {
    "kefir": {
      "numberOfDocuments": 1,
      "rawDocumentDbSize": 5320,
      "avgDocumentSize": 92,
      "isIndexing": false,
      "fieldDistribution": {
        "age": 1,
        "description": 1,
        "id": 1,
        "name": 1,
        "surname": 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### field description

- `rawDocumentDbSize` corresponds to the total size of the documents stored in Meilisearch.
- `avgDocumentSize` corresponds to the total size of the documents stored in Meilisearch divided by the number of documents.

## Impacted teams

- @meilisearch/docs-team 
- @meilisearch/integration-team 

## Cancelled field

- `maxDocumentSize`: this field implementation has been cancelled for performance reasons, computing the max document size needs to iterate over the whole database to find the biggest document which is not affordable for every indexing process
comments:
The current implementation has too much impact on the indexing time and can't be merged at this state without more efficient stats computing.

To be discussed with the @meilisearch/product-team

review_comments:
Oh wow, are we sure we want something like that?
I guess we won’t have the time for anything else before Thursday but can’t we compute it iteratively during the indexing pipeline since we know which documents are added, updated or removed and from which fields? 🤔
